findings.title: Cover search accepts the uncovered cast cell, so the pawn stays in the open instead of falling back to its original position
findings.detail: Vanilla TryFindCastPosition checks the caster's own cell first and finally returns true for any reachable, hittable cell scoring above 0.001; wantCoverFromTarget only adds to the score. Now that the search is centred on the pawn (maxRangeFromCaster = 6, no locus), with no cover within 6 tiles the best cell is usually the cell the pawn cast from (no distance penalty). MakeReturnJob then sees cell == pawn.Position, returns null and ClearHome runs: the pawn stays uncovered and never walks back, which contradicts AAI_ReturnTo_Cover_Tip ('If there is none, it walks back to its original position'). One change in the CastPositionRequest at AbilityAI.cs:1009-1016: add validator = c => CoverUtility.CalculateOverallBlockChance(c, enemy.Position, pawn.Map) > 0f, so uncovered cells (the cast cell included) are rejected and the search fails over to state.home.

findings.title: On the no-cast path the cover search centres on where the walk stopped, not where the pawn cast
findings.detail: ReturnJob (a Full walk that ended without a cast) also calls MakeReturnJob, so the search is centred on wherever the walk out was cut short. The comments on MakeReturnJob/TryFindCoverCell and the tooltip say 'where it cast'. Probably acceptable behaviour, but the wording doesn't match it.
